title: CLI/terminal client
description: Text-mode client for dev/testing. Renders board state as ASCII/Unicode art, accepts moves via text commands. Useful for SSH play, accessibility, and rapid prototyping without a browser. Low priority — Python REPL partially fills this role already.
close_reason: Terminal client: ASCII grid rendering, text command parsing (place/move/pass/resign/flip/remove), token reconnection. python -m baize.cli. 15 tests.
